contract: Requesting more than one episode download emits episode_download_queued once per waiting episode with the download client JSON (id, episodeDisplayTitle, url, libraryItemId, libraryId, isFinished false, failed false, appendRandomId, startedAt null, createdAt, finishedAt null, podcastTitle, podcastExplicit, season, episode, episodeType, publishedAt, guid). episode_* events use SocketAuthority.emitter, which sends to every socket that has an authenticated user, without a library/permission filter; a socket that never authenticated receives nothing.
exceptions: normal, error and edge facets are covered by the listed scenarios.
force is not applicable: the event has no force/override trigger.

Upstream sends episode_* events to every authenticated user without a library or tag permission filter (SocketAuthority.emitter); a listener without access to the podcast item still receives them. That authorisation gap is deliberately not asserted because no client offers those events to a user who cannot access the item, and the packet asserts only that unauthenticated sockets receive nothing.

invariants.contract: Requesting more than one episode download emits episode_download_queued once per waiting episode with the download client JSON (id, episodeDisplayTitle, url, libraryItemId, libraryId, isFinished false, failed false, appendRandomId, startedAt null, createdAt, finishedAt null, podcastTitle, podcastExplicit, season, episode, episodeType, publishedAt, guid).

The event reaches every authenticated socket, including a non-admin listener that may access the library, and never reaches a socket that did not authenticate; a rejected (403) request that would trigger the event emits nothing.
